chunks: And Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام ruled:

Concerning two women who were sisters: a man married one of them, then divorced her while she was pregnant. Then he proposed to her sister and married her before her divorced sister had given birth to her child. So he ordered him to divorce the other one until her divorced sister gave birth to her child; then he could propose to her again and give her her dowry twice.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man marries his divorced pregnant wife's sister before she gives birth?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal ruling of Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام regarding marriage to two sisters when one sister is still in her waiting period due to pregnancy. It establishes that the second marriage must be ended until the first wife's pregnancy-based 'iddah concludes, after which a new proposal and dowry are required.
